sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r1/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (sheet1 row 27 = check 26; sheet4 row 27 with Mukesh annotation: verifiers combined in one flow need not be retested separately)
evidence: Built requirement->criterion map over instruction.md, conversations.md, walls-and-retention.md and integration.md against the 17 functional, 5 polish, 4 visual and 2 gate criteria. Most requirements map (walls by every route, live wall, timers incl. exact 7-day boundary and partner-only timer change, hold scope/release/delete-refusal, nested replies and order, stale edit, safe formatting, links, mentions, unread/new-messages line, idempotent send and order, live updates keeping draft/scroll, search, transcript, persistence, signed-out denial, phone width, refusal-in-place). Template runtime policy (Node/SQLite/DB_PATH/health) is shared template policy and not counted. Ungraded asked-for behaviors (not bundled in any flow; no criterion step or Fails clause exercises them): (1) walls-and-retention.md:29 'A partner places or releases a hold' - no criterion has a non-partner (associate/client) try to place or release a hold; hold_scope_and_release (functional judge.toml:138-146) only acts as Harriet. (2) walls-and-retention.md:19 'Harriet can add or lift a wall' - no criterion checks that a non-partner (e.g. walled Dev) cannot add/lift walls; wall_added_live (judge.toml:74-81) only uses Harriet. This is a wall-bypass route given 'by any route' language. (3) conversations.md:9 'authors can edit their own messages ... Authors can also delete their own messages' - no criterion checks a non-author edit/delete is refused (edits_and_stale_edit and message_links only use the author). (4) conversations.md:25 'Deleted messages don't count as unread' - unread_and_new_messages_line (judge.toml:182-189) never deletes an unread message. (5) conversations.md:31 live updates for 'replies ... or a message disappears' - live_updates_keep_my_work (judge.toml:207-215) covers only a new top-level post and an edit; no criterion checks a deletion/expiry or reply propagating to an open tab without reload. (6) conversations.md:9 'a deleted message with replies leaves the same placeholder as one a timer removed' - only timer-removed placeholders are checked (deleted_and_expired_seed_messages); the author-deleted JUDGE-P2 in message_links has no replies. (7) conversations.md:13 markup literal 'in earlier versions' - safe_formatting (judge.toml:159-170) checks thread, reply quote, search snippet, transcript but never an edited message's earlier version. (8) walls-and-retention.md:35 transcript shows '"edited" if it was changed' - search_and_transcript Part B (judge.toml:217-233) checks heading, order, author, sent time, hold mark and versions but not the edited mark. Items 1-3 are authorization rules; items 4-8 are narrower legs. The skill/workbook flow exception (SKILL.md:64; workbook annotation) does not apply because these legs are absent, not bundled.
counterexample: A plausible broken app: any signed-in staff or client can place/release holds and add/lift walls (server checks only that a session exists), any user can edit or delete anyone's message, deleted messages still count toward unread, live polling refreshes only new posts and edits (deleted/expired messages linger in open tabs until reload), a user-deleted parent with replies shows a different placeholder (or vanishes with its quote kept), the edit-history view renders raw HTML, and transcripts omit 'edited'. Every functional, polish and visual criterion as written still passes, because each acts only as Harriet/the author on these surfaces and never exercises these legs. E.g. Dev (walled from M-12) could lift his own M-12 wall and read the matter, yet wall_every_route, wall_mentions_and_links and wall_added_live all pass.
suggested_fix: Add the missing legs to existing flows (keeping the 17-criterion timeout arithmetic in mind) or narrow the public brief: (a) in hold_scope_and_release, have sian@ or gwen@ attempt/replay a hold place and release and require refusal with unchanged hold; (b) in wall_added_live or wall_every_route, have dev@ replay Harriet's recorded wall-lift request for M-12 and require refusal and Dev still walled; (c) in edits_and_stale_edit or message_links, have another user replay the author's edit/delete request on that message and require refusal; (d) in unread_and_new_messages_line, delete one of the unread JUDGE-U messages before Dev opens and require the count to drop; (e) in live_updates_keep_my_work, also delete a message (or post a reply) from Harriet's tab and require it to disappear/appear in Gwen's tab without reload; (f) in message_links, give JUDGE-P2 a reply before deletion and require the timer-style placeholder; (g) in safe_formatting, edit the F1 message once and check its earlier version shows markup literally; (h) in search_and_transcript Part B, require the 'edited' mark on the held edited message. Alternatively remove the corresponding promises from the instructions if they are not intended to be graded.
